If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecasted decline in early horizon (1–7 days) by 5–10% to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecasted rise in early horizon (1–7 days) by 5–10% to counteract pessimism.  
In mid-horizon (8–15 days), if sentiment swings from positive to negative, shift forecast downward by 3–7% to reflect sentiment reversal.  
In late-horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment remains neutral or slightly positive, reduce forecasted volatility by 2–5% to align with stable sentiment.  
If sentiment shows strong upward momentum (≥0.80) over last 5 days, increase forecasted peak in mid-horizon (10–15 days) by 3–8% to capture sentiment-driven rally.  
If sentiment shows strong downward momentum (≤-0.80) over last 5 days, reduce forecasted peak in mid-horizon (10–15 days) by 3–8% to avoid overestimating fall.
